static_traits.name: Fang Lin
static_traits.social_status: Fairly close with friends, but hesitates to share own cooking results for fear of being evaluated
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy or counseling received in the past; never had similar psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, high cooperativeness, calm tone; able to engage in rational Reflection and evidence examination; subjectively reports Anxiety present and repeated doubt

basic_info.main_problem: I have been worrying about how friends will view the Italian food I cook, even though I myself greatly enjoy cooking.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these persistent doubts are affecting my enjoyment of cooking and causing unnecessary stress, which prompts me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: My cooking is not good enough
My worth depends on others' evaluations

special_situations.event: The situation of cooking Italian food for friends and about to serve it
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends do not like my dishes, it means I am not a good Chef
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Worries repeatedly before serving and pursues perfection to avoid negative evaluation, or shares less with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think it is not good; they will be disappointed

special_situations.event: Thinks about sharing his own Italian food at social occasions
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly speculating about friends' views before sharing, trying to suppress worries with self-comfort but with poor effect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may think I am no good; they will look down on my cooking skills

special_situations.event: Recalls friends' past praise and positive feedback about one's cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive feedback is not enough to prove ability; one must keep Gaining recognition to be qualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Negating or weakening positive evidence, continuing to agonize over potential negative reviews
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: That praise does not count; they are just being polite

special_situations.event: Graduate student in the final year with increasing Academic pressure, approaching a dinner with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If performing poorly under pressure, friends will evaluate one as not good
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises standards, blames oneself harshly, reduces proactively inviting friends to taste
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I might mess up; they will be disappointed

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized by friends, to be accepted, enjoying the experience of Freely sharing and being appreciated
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being negated and judged, worrying about being seen as 'not good enough' and feeling shame
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being negated through caution and evidence examination, reducing exposure to maintain safety

object_relations.self_representation: An Anxious people-pleaser (worrying about not being good enough, needing others' recognition)
object_relations.object_representation: Judgmental others (friends who may be disappointed or negating)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about how friends might evaluate her cooking, or when asked in counseling to examine evidence and automatic thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe only sufficient evidence can prevent others' negation, otherwise friends will not like one's dishes (treating others as objects who may judge at any time)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using an objective, neutral tone, listing supporting and counter evidence, discussing probabilities and facts, minimizing emotional words and self-evaluation.

manifestations: Feeling bound by others' evaluations when cooking and sharing, struggling to act Freely according to one's own preferences
Shifts attention from self-experience to external approval, hesitates to share

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'having', expressed in language like:'he looks down on me','they want to exclude me', etc.
manifestations: Repeatedly guessing friends will not like one's dishes
Presupposing others' negative evaluations before actually receiving real feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Over-scrutinizes and berates herself before sharing, pursuing perfection to avoid bad reviews
Invites friends to taste less often for fear of judgment

positive_force: Has stable interest in and enjoyment of cooking itself
Has previously received positive feedback from friends (compliments, requests for recipes)
Has the willingness to rationally examine evidence and adjust expectations (positive attitude)
Has a friend group to rely on (social support available)
negative_force: Excessively concerned with others' evaluations, seeking external validation
Frequent automatic thoughts (mind reading, predicting the future, negating the positive)
Academic pressure spilling over into other life areas, increasing Anxiety levels
Avoidance and hesitation arise from worry about being judged; reduces sharing

target_behavior.behavior: Experiencing Significant anxiety and avoidance when cooking for friends or thinking about sharing (hesitating, reducing invitations)
antecedent: Cooking Italian food for friends and preparing to serve it
Thinking about sharing dishes at social gatherings
Graduate student in the final year with Increased stress
target_behavior.core_reason: Over-focusing on external evaluation and potential negation, with automatic thoughts (mind reading, predicting the future, negating the positive) activated under stress, causing self-worth and performance to be overly tied to others' views
target_behavior.function: Escaping being judged and possible shame, to reduce immediate Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Diminished enjoyment of cooking; reduced interaction and sharing with friends; impaired attention and Decreased productivity, daily Increased stress
